punchline: Brian Tracy's two buyer fears, losing money and making a mistake, appear on no spec sheet.
thirty_sec: Brian Tracy's sales book claims all buying is emotional. Buyers want security, status, health, growth and love, and they fear two things: losing money and making a mistake. Neuroscience adds a caution. A patient who lost his emotions could no longer decide well, which shows feeling is part of choosing, but not that reasoning plays no part.
